incrementalWelcome.title: Welcome back
incrementalWelcome.description: Here are the new features added since your last visit. This short tour will show you what's changed.

welcome.title: Welcome to Loom
welcome.description: Loom is a document search and review workspace. It can index, OCR, tag, flag, translate, and summarize your files, all in one place. This short tour will walk you through the main tools.

globalSearch.title: Search and sort
globalSearch.description: Type keywords or a query expression and press Enter to search. Use the sort button to choose a metadata field and flip between ascending and descending order.

queryOverview.title: Explore query examples
queryOverview.description: Queries can combine text, metadata fields, Boolean operators, phrases, wildcards, ranges, and dates. The examples here are clickable starting points for exploring your own collection.

keyboardShortcuts.title: Work faster with keyboard shortcuts
keyboardShortcuts.description: Use arrow keys to move between results and Enter to open them. Further shortcuts let you flag, tag, translate, and summarize documents without reaching for the mouse.

searchAll.title: Try digging into your data now
searchAll.description: Click the button below to run a search for all documents. The tour will continue once the first results load, so you can see the tools in action on real data.

resultsTabs.title: Results and document tabs
resultsTabs.description: The Results tab stays pinned and shows how many documents are loaded out of the total matches. Documents open in additional tabs beside it. Scroll down or use the load-more button to bring in more results.

resultCard.title: Work with a result
resultCard.description: Click a card to select it. Double-click opens its full detail view; Ctrl-click opens it in a background tab without leaving your current results. The footer shows the active sort field and its value for that document.

resultCardPath.title: Identity, path, and status
resultCardPath.description: The file-type icon marks unseen files with a visual indicator. The document path is shown below it. Bold text means the file is unseen, red means it has been flagged. Other icons reveal details and let you apply quick filters; hold Shift to exclude rather than include.

resultCardProcessingStatus.title: Document processing status
resultCardProcessingStatus.description: A scissors icon means the file's content was too long and was cut short. A broken-link icon means Loom stopped extracting nested attachments after going too many levels deep. Click either icon to filter for documents with that status, or hold Shift to exclude them. A red Failed badge opens the task history with error details and a retry option.

resultCardSubitems.title: Attachments and related items
resultCardSubitems.description: Attachments and documents extracted from this file appear below the path. Click to open them in their own tabs, or Ctrl-click to open them in the background. Sub-documents also show a link back to the file they came from.

resultCardContent.title: Preview content and matches
resultCardContent.description: Switch between extracted text, summary, translation, and AI image-description previews when available. Match highlights show which parts of the document matched your query. Click one to filter by that phrase or to sort by that specific field.

resultCardTags.title: Organize and filter with tags
resultCardTags.description: Tags organize documents and also act as query filters. Click a tag to include it, hold Shift to exclude it, use the overflow for additional tags, and use the tag action to add or remove labels.

resultCardActions.title: Document actions
resultCardActions.description: Primary actions let you flag, mark as seen, tag, share, download, or open the full detail view. More actions include translation, summarization, AI image description, reindexing, and options to control whether the document appears in results.

resultCardPreview.title: Thumbnail preview
resultCardPreview.description: The thumbnail shows a visual snapshot of the document. Its badge displays the total number of pages or frames. Click it to open the full rendered view.

documentDetail.title: Full document workspace
documentDetail.description: The document view organizes everything about a file into tabs: rendered previews, extracted text, translations, search highlights, summaries, and more. Tabs are disabled when no data is available for that document.

detailRendered.title: Rendered view and controls
detailRendered.description: Choose a rendering mode (Office PDF, Browser PDF, Image, or Email) to control how the document is displayed; if one mode looks wrong, try another. For PDF modes, toggle a page outline or thumbnail strip to navigate long documents. You can also zoom, rotate, or go full-screen.

detailTranslations.title: Machine translations
detailTranslations.description: The Translations tab shows automatically translated versions of the document text. Select a language to read the translation in the editor below.

detailHighlights.title: Query match highlights
detailHighlights.description: Highlights show the exact passages and document fields where your search terms were found. Click a field name to add it as a filter and limit results to documents that matched in that same field.

detailRaw.title: Raw indexed data
detailRaw.description: The Raw tab shows everything Loom extracted and stored for this document: metadata, detected language, processing history, and more, in structured JSON format. Useful for troubleshooting or for technical users who want to inspect the underlying data.

activityBar.title: Workspace tools
activityBar.description: The toolbar gives you access to upload, folders, tags, saved queries, bulk actions, automatic actions, statistics, and document chat.

activityBarLeft.title: Global tools
activityBarLeft.description: These buttons open the left sidebar, which contains global views: tools that are independent of your current search query. Here you can upload files, browse the complete folder hierarchy, manage tags, access saved queries, and customise how result cards look and behave.

activityBarRight.title: Query-scoped tools
activityBarRight.description: These buttons open the right sidebar, which contains query-scoped views. Everything here reflects only the files that match your current search. Use Folder (filtered) to navigate matching files by path, Statistics to explore distributions and charts, Chat to ask the AI assistant questions about your results, and Bulk Actions to act on the entire result set.

upload.title: Upload your files
upload.description: Click here to upload files directly from your computer. Loom also supports the S3 protocol. Any file placed in the loom-intake bucket is automatically discovered, indexed, and made searchable. No manual steps needed.

folderIcon.title: Browse your folders
folderIcon.description: Click this icon to open the folder browser. It shows the complete hierarchy of all indexed files, regardless of your current search query.

folders.title: Global folder view
folders.description: This is the global folder view. It always shows the complete folder hierarchy of all indexed files, regardless of the current search query. Use it to navigate your full archive at any time.

folderTreeNode.title: Folder node counts
folderTreeNode.description: Each node shows up to four counts: a red flag for flagged documents, a yellow dot for unseen documents, a folder icon for files directly in this folder, and a document icon for all files in this folder and its subfolders. Counts roll up through parent folders. Bold names contain unseen files; red names contain flagged files.

folderFilter.title: Filter by name
folderFilter.description: Type to narrow the folder list by name. The filter is case-insensitive and clears automatically when you switch to a different tool.

tagsIcon.title: Browse by tag
tagsIcon.description: Click this icon to open the tag browser and filter documents by their assigned tags.

tags.title: Browse by tag
tags.description: Browse and filter the tag list, then click a tag to narrow the current search to documents with that tag. Hold Shift while clicking to exclude that tag from results instead.

savedQueriesIcon.title: Saved queries
savedQueriesIcon.description: Click this icon to open your saved searches. Save any query and return to it instantly with a single click.

savedQueries.title: Reuse saved queries
savedQueries.description: Save the current query so you can rerun it later and track its match count. Queries with newly matching documents since your last visit show a badge. You can filter the list or delete queries you no longer need.

bulkActions.title: Act on every match
bulkActions.description: Bulk actions apply to the complete query result set, not only cards currently loaded on screen. Available operations include flagging, seen state, tags, translation, summaries, image descriptions, reindexing, visibility, and archive creation.

cardCustomization.title: Customise how results look
cardCustomization.description: The Card Customisation panel lets you control what each result card shows and how it behaves. It is divided into three sections: Card Display, Card Fields, and Auto Actions.

cardCustomizationDisplay.title: Card Display
cardCustomizationDisplay.description: Choose a density preset to control how much information each card shows. Compact fits more results on screen; Comfortable shows more detail. Switch to Custom to fine-tune individual elements such as thumbnails, highlights, tags, and action buttons.

cardCustomizationFields.title: Card Fields
cardCustomizationFields.description: Toggle individual metadata fields on or off to control which values appear on each card. Only fields that exist in your indexed data are listed here.

cardCustomizationAutoActions.title: Auto Actions
cardCustomizationAutoActions.description: Automatic actions run when you open or interact with a result. Enable any combination of mark-as-seen, flag, translate, summarise, describe images, or reindex, so routine tasks happen without manual steps.

filteredFolder.title: Filtered folder view
filteredFolder.description: The filtered folder view shows only folders and files matching your current query, a query-scoped companion to the global folder view on the left. The tree resets with each new search.

statistics.title: Analyze the result set
statistics.description: Open statistics to explore metadata distributions and grouped histograms for the active query. Selecting chart segments or dragging ranges adds them as search filters.

statisticsPieChart.title: Distribution pie chart
statisticsPieChart.description: The pie chart shows the top values for the selected metadata dimension. Click a slice to filter results to that value, or hold Shift to exclude it. Hover over a slice to see its exact count.

statisticsHistogram.title: Grouped histogram
statisticsHistogram.description: The histogram groups documents over time or numeric ranges. Bar colors correspond to the values shown in the pie chart. Click a bar segment to filter by that group, or drag to select a date or value range.

chat.title: Ask across all your documents
chat.description: The chatbot answers questions across all indexed documents, not just the current search results. Source references link back to the supporting documents so you can inspect them directly.

chatInput.title: Ask a question
chatInput.description: Type your question here and press Enter. The AI searches across all your indexed documents, synthesises an answer, and links back to the source documents it used.

chatSourcesWarning.title: ⚠️ Answers may be inaccurate
chatSourcesWarning.description: The chatbot uses AI to generate answers, which means it can produce plausible-sounding but incorrect information. Each answer includes clickable source citations. Always expand them and check the referenced documents to verify important claims before acting on them.

chatDeepSearch.title: Research Mode
chatDeepSearch.description: Research Mode searches your entire document collection to answer broad, cross-document questions. Unlike normal chat, it cannot interact with the frontend while doing so. Use normal chat to explore your current results interactively.

chatHistory.title: Conversation history
chatHistory.description: Click here to browse all your previous conversations. You can search through them and pick up where you left off.

chatNewChat.title: Start a new conversation
chatNewChat.description: Click here to open a fresh conversation. Each conversation has its own context and is saved automatically.

fileDetail.title: File Detail
fileDetail.description: The File Detail panel shows metadata and content for whichever file is currently highlighted. Its content is also query-scoped: highlights, translations, and summaries reflect the active search query.

encryptionKeyDisplay.title: Shared encryption key
encryptionKeyDisplay.description: This is your Loom instance's encryption key. Any two Loom instances that share the same key can exchange .loom archives fully end-to-end encrypted. The key never leaves your infrastructure.

processingStatus.title: Monitor processing health
processingStatus.description: Header indicators show the health of background processing. Icons flag files with truncated content, skipped attachments, or failed tasks. Click any indicator to search for the affected files. This area also shows active processing progress and whether queues are paused.

navigation.title: Move between sections
navigation.description: Use the header tabs to switch between Search and Archives. Any documents you had open are waiting for you when you return to Search.

headerArchivesTab.title: Switch to Archives
headerArchivesTab.description: This button takes you to the Archives section, where all your exported packages live. Open it now to take a look.

bulkActionCreateArchive.title: Export the result set
bulkActionCreateArchive.description: Create Archive packages the entire query result set, every indexed file, not just what's on screen, into a downloadable archive scoped to your current search. Each archive contains everything Loom produced during indexing: the original files, all extracted and generated metadata, rendered previews, thumbnails, translations, summaries, and more. This makes archives a complete transfer unit: import one into another Loom instance and it will have the full state, no reprocessing needed.

archivesList.title: Download your archives
archivesList.description: Archives appear here as they finish building. Each archive is available in two forms: a plain .zip for general use, and an encrypted .loom file. The .loom format can be safely transferred between two Loom instances that share the same master key, making it ideal for moving data between trusted deployments.

archivesUpload.title: Import an archive
archivesUpload.description: Use this button to import an archive from another Loom instance. Both formats are supported: the encrypted .loom file and the plain .zip. All metadata is preserved in the archive, so the import is fast and no reprocessing happens.

archiveCliIntro.title: Your archive includes a CLI
archiveCliIntro.description: Every .zip contains a self-contained cli.py. No installation required, just a standard Python interpreter. It works out of the box on Windows, Linux, and macOS. Extract the archive and run python cli.py to open an interactive shell with tab completion, persistent history, and Ctrl+R search.

archiveCliDemo.title: Browse, search, and extract offline
archiveCliDemo.description:
The CLI surfaces everything Loom produced: extracted text, metadata, translations, and rendered previews. Navigate the archive as a virtual filesystem with cd. Commands like cat and grep work relative to your current directory, and the prompt updates to reflect where you are.
loom> ls
  reports/annual.pdf
  photos/field-ops.jpg
loom> cd reports/
loom/reports> cat annual.pdf
  Jahresbericht 2024 — Dieser Bericht
  enthält vertrauliche Finanzdaten...
loom/reports> translate annual.pdf en
  Annual Report 2024 — This report
  contains confidential financial data...
loom/reports> cd ..
loom> tree
  .
  ├── photos/
  │   └── field-ops.jpg
  └── reports/
      └── annual.pdf

menu.title: More tools
menu.description: Open this menu to access the built-in AI chat interface and other supporting tools. Click About to view version information or to restart this tour.

conclusion.title: Happy exploring!
conclusion.description: That's the tour. Dive into your collection, refine queries, and organize your findings at your own pace. Restart this tour any time from the About dialog.

demoMode.title: Interactive Demo
demoMode.introduction: A browser-only preview of Loom using a curated set of sample documents. No backend needed.
demoMode.limitations: File uploads, imports, and backend services are unavailable. Changes reset on reload.

This can lead to data loss, malware infection, or unauthorized access to your system.

tips.title: Try these tips to refine your search
tips.prefix: search for all strings starting with "Jo"
tips.fuzzy: fuzzy search for word "John" in all files with maximum of 2 replacements
tips.exact: search for the exact term "John Smith"
tips.exactDistance: search for both "John" and "Smith" with maximum distance of 10 words
tips.size: search for all files larger than 1 Megabyte (options: "M" for Megabytes, "K" for Kilobytes)
tips.when: search for all files modified today (options: today, yesterday, thisweek, thismonth, thisyear)
tips.author: list all authors
tips.tagsNegate: search for files NOT tagged with "interesting"
tips.and: search for all files tagged with "interesting" and have a timestamp from today
tips.or: search for all files tagged with "interesting" or have a timestamp from today
tips.allHidden: search for both hidden and not hidden files
tips.mediaType: filter by broad media category (image, video, audio, text, application, …)
tips.uploadTime: search for all files uploaded on or before 2020-06-15
tips.creationTime: search for all files created after 2020 but before 2025
tips.modificationTime: search for all files modified after 2020 but before 2025
tips.secrets: search for all files containing secrets
tips.summary: filter to files that have an AI-generated summary
tips.allFields: search in all fields for "John" (including metadata fields)
tips.nameFields: search for the substring "txt" in all fields containing the string "name"
